description: For integrable f on ℝⁿ and λ>0, the Lebesgue measure of {Mf>λ} is at most C_n∥f∥₁/λ, with a constant depending only on n.

title: Density of continuous compactly supported functions in Euclidean L¹
description: Every function in L¹(ℝⁿ) can be approximated in L¹ norm by continuous compactly supported functions.

title: Weak Lᵖ space
description: For 0<p<∞ on a measure space, weak Lᵖ consists of measurable f with sup_{λ>0}λ μ({|f|>λ})^{1/p}<∞, modulo almost-everywhere equality.

title: Modular of a variable-exponent Lebesgue space
description: For an exponent p(x)∈(0,∞), the modular is ρ_p(f)=∫|f(x)|^{p(x)}dx. The Luxemburg quasi-norm tests whether this modular becomes at most one after scaling f.

title: Vector-valued maximal inequality with variable Lᵖ exponent and fixed sequence exponent
description: If p is globally log-Hölder with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1<q<∞ is constant, then ∥(∑_j|Mf_j|^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}≤C∥(∑_j|f_j|^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}.

title: Jensen estimate for variable-exponent local averages
description: For globally log-Hölder p with 1≤p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and k≥0, some β∈(0,1) gives (β avg_B|f|)^{p(x)}≤avg_B|f(y)|^{p(y)}+min(|B|^k,1)[(e+|x|)^{-k}+avg_B(e+|y|)^{-k}] for x∈B and ∥f∥_{p(·)}≤1. Here B is any ball; constants depend on the fixed exponent and k.

title: Singular value decomposition of a real matrix
description: Every real m×n matrix is UΣVᵀ with U,V orthogonal and Σ rectangular diagonal with nonnegative entries, its singular values.

title: Polar coordinates in the Euclidean plane
description: A point is written (r cosθ,r sinθ) with r≥0; away from zero, r>0 and the angle is understood modulo2π.

title: Jacobian matrix of a differentiable Euclidean map
description: For f:ℝⁿ→ℝᵐ, its Jacobian matrix at a point has entries ∂f_i/∂x_j. For m=n its determinant is the Jacobian determinant.

title: Frobenius norm of a real or complex matrix
description: The Frobenius norm of A is (∑_{i,j}|a_{ij}|²)^{1/2}.

title: Inverse function theorem in Euclidean space
description: A continuously differentiable map between open subsets of ℝⁿ whose derivative is invertible at a point restricts near that point to a C¹ diffeomorphism. A C^k or smooth map has an inverse of the same regularity.

title: Chain rule for Fréchet derivatives
description: If g is Fréchet differentiable at x and f at g(x), then f∘g is Fréchet differentiable at x with D(f∘g)(x)=Df(g(x))∘Dg(x).

title: Mixed discriminant of square matrices
description: The symmetric multilinear coefficient D(A₁,…,A_n) in det(∑t_iA_i), normalized by D(A,…,A)=det A.

title: Alexandrov’s inequality for mixed discriminants
description: For real symmetric A and positive definite real symmetric B,M₃,…,M_n, D(A,B,M₃,…,M_n)²≥D(A,A,M₃,…,M_n)D(B,B,M₃,…,M_n).

title: Curvature matrix of a smooth support function
description: At u∈S^{n−1}, restrict the Euclidean Hessian of the1-homogeneous extension of h to u⊥; this equals the spherical Hessian ∇²_Sh+hI. Positive definiteness describes the strictly curved support functions used in the smooth argument.

title: Divergence theorem in Euclidean space
description: For a bounded domain with C¹ boundary and a C¹ vector field F on its closure, ∫_Ωdiv F dx=∫_{∂Ω}F·ν dS, where ν is the outer unit normal.

title: Continuity of mixed volume under Hausdorff convergence
description: If each sequence K_{i,j} of convex bodies converges in Hausdorff distance to K_i, then V(K_{1,j},…,K_{n,j})→V(K₁,…,K_n).

title: Integral representation of mixed volume using curvature matrices
description: For C² convex bodies with positive definite curvature matrices, V(K₁,…,K_n)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_{K₁}D(D²h_{K₂},…,D²h_{K_n})dS, where D² is the curvature matrix of the homogeneous support function.

title: Discrete spectral theorem for self-adjoint elliptic operators on closed manifolds
description: A symmetric uniformly elliptic second-order differential operator with smooth coefficients on a closed smooth manifold, in L² of a smooth positive density, has a self-adjoint extension with domain H² and discrete real spectrum with an orthonormal basis of smooth eigenfunctions.

title: Principal eigenvalue theorem for a scalar elliptic operator on a closed manifold
description: A self-adjoint uniformly elliptic scalar operator with real coefficients on a connected closed smooth manifold, whose principal part is ∑a^{ij}∂ᵢ∂ⱼ with positive definite (a^{ij}), has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction. Any strictly positive eigenfunction corresponds to that eigenvalue.

title: Reverse Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for a form of positive index at most one
description: If a real symmetric bilinear form B has no two-dimensional positive definite subspace, then B(x,y)²≥B(x,x)B(y,y) whenever B(y,y)>0.

title: Surface-area integral formula for first mixed volume
description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_L(u)dS_K(u).

title: Minkowski’s first inequality for mixed volumes
description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)^n≥|K|^{n−1}|L|, with equality exactly when K and L are homothetic.

title: Approximation of a convex body by polytopes
description: Every Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of convex hulls of finite point sets.

title: Continuity of projection volume under Hausdorff convergence
description: For a fixed linear subspace E, Hausdorff convergence of convex bodies K_j to K implies convergence of the Euclidean volumes of K_j|E to that of K|E.

title: Distribution on an open Euclidean set
description: A continuous linear functional on C_c^∞(Ω), where test functions on each fixed compact support converge with all derivatives uniformly. It need not extend to a tempered distribution.

title: Distributional Laplacian
description: For a distribution T on an open Euclidean set, its Laplacian is defined by (ΔT)(φ)=T(Δφ), with Δ=∑ᵢ∂ᵢ².

title: Positive distributions are Radon measures
description: A distribution T satisfying T(φ)≥0 for every nonnegative smooth compactly supported test function is integration against a unique positive Radon measure.

title: Weyl’s lemma for harmonic distributions
description: A distribution annihilated by the Euclidean Laplacian is represented by a smooth harmonic function.

title: Logarithmic fundamental solution of −Δ in the plane
description: The locally integrable function Γ(x)=(2π)⁻¹log(1/|x|) on ℝ² satisfies −ΔΓ=δ₀ in the distributional sense.

title: Harnack convergence theorem for monotone harmonic functions
description: An increasing sequence of positive harmonic functions on a connected domain either tends to∞ everywhere or converges uniformly on compact subsets to a harmonic function. A decreasing sequence bounded below by a harmonic function has a harmonic limit if finite at one point.

title: Existence of a greatest harmonic minorant on the unit disk
description: A superharmonic function on the unit disk that has a subharmonic minorant not identically−∞ has a greatest harmonic function lying below it.

title: Minimum principle for superharmonic functions
description: A superharmonic function on a bounded domain with nonnegative lower boundary limits is nonnegative throughout the domain. An interior minimum forces it to be constant on that connected component.

title: Poisson representation of positive harmonic functions on the disk
description: Every nonnegative harmonic function h on the unit disk is uniquely h(z)=∫_T(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²dμ(ζ) for a finite positive Borel measure μ on the unit circle.

title: Distributional characterization of superharmonic functions
description: A locally integrable function with nonnegative distribution−Δu has a unique superharmonic representative equal to it almost everywhere. Conversely every superharmonic function is locally integrable and has−Δu≥0.

title: Binary expansion of a nonnegative number
description: For a nonnegative real number, a representation x=∑_kb_k2ᵏ with digits b_k∈{0,1}; integers use finitely many nonnegative powers, while fractional parts may use a convergent series of negative powers. Dyadic fractional values use the terminating convention when uniqueness is needed.

title: Bitwise exclusive-or
description: For finite binary strings of equal length, exclusive-or adds corresponding digits modulo2. Binary integers are padded with zeros, and binary fractions are aligned by place value before applying the same operation.

title: Field with two elements
description: The field F₂={0,1} with1+1=0 and the usual identities0+a=a,1·a=a,0·a=0.

title: Primitive polynomial over a finite field
description: A monic irreducible polynomial p of degree s over F_q is primitive if the residue class of x generates the multiplicative group of the field F_q[x]/(p), which has qˢ elements.

title: Sobol sequence in a finite-dimensional unit cube
description: For each coordinate choose a primitive binary polynomial xˢ+a₁xˢ⁻¹+⋯+a_{s−1}x+1 and odd initial m_k<2ᵏ for1≤k≤s. Continue m_k=(⊕_{i=1}^{s−1}2ⁱa_im_{k−i})⊕2ˢm_{k−s}⊕m_{k−s}, and put v_k=m_k/2ᵏ. The n-th coordinate is ⊕_kn_kv_k, where n_k are binary digits of n. A standard first coordinate uses v_k=2⁻ᵏ. Gray-code indexing reorders each initial power-of-two block; polynomial and direction-number choices specify the sequence.

title: Discrete sine transform of type I
description: The orthonormal real transform on ℝᴺ given by (Sy)_j=√(2/(N+1))∑_{k=1}ᴺy_k sin(πjk/(N+1)),1≤j≤N. Other discrete sine transform types are separate conventions.

title: Discrete orthonormal Haar transform on a dyadic grid
description: For a vector of length2ᵐ, replace each consecutive pair by its normalized sum and difference, (a+b)/√2 and(a−b)/√2, then recursively transform the sums until a single average remains. Order the average and detail coefficients by scale.

title: Spectral theorem for a real symmetric matrix
description: Every real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal basis of real eigenvectors; equivalently A=UΛUᵀ with U orthogonal and Λ real diagonal.

title: Multi-index for Euclidean partial derivatives
description: An n-tuple α=(α₁,…,α_n) of nonnegative integers, with |α|=∑α_i; Dᵅ denotes taking α_i partial derivatives in coordinate i.

title: Sobolev space Wᵏ,ᵖ of a Euclidean domain
description: For integer k≥0 and1≤p≤∞, Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω) consists of Lᵖ functions whose distributional partial derivatives Dᵅ for all |α|≤k also lie in Lᵖ. A norm combines the finitely many derivative Lᵖ norms.

title: Continuously differentiable Euclidean map
description: A map on an open Euclidean set whose first coordinate partial derivatives exist and are continuous.

title: C¹ domain in Euclidean space
description: An open connected subset of ℝᵈ whose boundary near every point can, after a rigid change of coordinates, be written as the graph of a C¹ function, with the domain locally on one side.

title: Lipschitz domain in Euclidean space
description: An open connected Euclidean set whose boundary is locally the graph of a Lipschitz function, with the domain locally on one side.

title: C¹,¹ domain in Euclidean space
description: A C¹ domain whose local boundary graph functions have Lipschitz continuous first derivatives.

title: Smooth domain in Euclidean space
description: An open connected Euclidean set whose boundary is locally the graph of a C∞ function, with the domain locally on one side.

title: Injective function
description: A function f is injective if f(x)=f(y) implies x=y for all points of its domain.

title: Continuous linear embedding of normed spaces
description: An injective bounded linear map, usually used to identify one normed space with a linear subspace of another.

title: Relatively compact subset of a topological space
description: A subset whose closure is compact.

title: Compact linear operator
description: A bounded linear operator between normed spaces that maps every bounded subset to a relatively compact subset.

title: Reflexive Banach space
description: A Banach space X for which the canonical isometric map X→X**, sending x to the functional ℓ↦ℓ(x), is onto.

title: Gelfand triple of Banach and Hilbert spaces
description: A reflexive real Banach space V embedded continuously and densely in a real Hilbert space H, with H identified with its continuous dual so that V⊂H⊂V*. The duality V*×V extends the H inner product.

title: Banach-valued simple function
description: A measurable function with finitely many values in a Banach space, represented as a finite sum∑_ix_i1_{A_i} with measurable sets A_i.

title: Strongly measurable Banach-valued function
description: A function that is an almost-everywhere pointwise norm limit of Banach-valued simple functions.

title: Bochner integral
description: For a strongly measurable Banach-valued f with ∫‖f‖<∞, its integral is the norm limit of the integrals of simple approximants converging in the integral of their norm difference; simple functions integrate by∑x_iμ(A_i).

title: Bochner Lᵖ space
description: For a Banach space X, Lᵖ(S;X) consists of strongly measurable X-valued functions modulo a.e. equality with finite norm(∫‖f‖ᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ for1≤p<∞; use essential supremum for p=∞.

title: Weak time derivative of a Banach-valued function
description: An integrable X-valued v is the weak derivative of u on an interval if∫u(t)φ′(t)dt=−∫v(t)φ(t)dt as Bochner integrals for every compactly supported smooth scalar test function φ.

title: Aubin–Lions compactness lemma
description: Let X₀↪X↪X₁ be Banach spaces, the first embedding compact and the second continuous. For1<p<∞ and1<q≤∞, a set bounded in Lᵖ(0,T;X₀) whose weak time derivatives are bounded in Lᑫ(0,T;X₁) is relatively compact in Lᵖ(0,T;X).

title: Sobolev embedding W²,ᵖ into continuous functions
description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain Ω⊂ℝᵈ, if1<p<∞ and2p>d, every W²,ᵖ function has a continuous representative on the closure, with sup norm bounded by C‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}.

title: W²,ᵖ regularity of the Dirichlet Poisson problem
description: On a bounded C¹,¹ domain and2≤p<∞, for f∈Lᵖ the weak solution u∈H₀¹ of−Δu=f belongs to W²,ᵖ and satisfies‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}≤C‖f‖_{Lᵖ}.

title: Variational pressure theorem for the imitative monomer–dimer model
description: For complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer parameters h∈ℝ,J≥0, let g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2 and p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)). Then lim_NN⁻¹logZ_N=max_{m∈[0,1]}{−Jm²+p₀(h+(2m−1)J)}.

title: Coexistence curve and critical point of the imitative monomer–dimer model
description: For J>0 and the variational function in the pressure theorem, there is a critical endpoint m_c=2−√2,J_c=(3+2√2)/4,h_c=½log(2√2−2)−¼. A coexistence curve h=γ(J),J>J_c, has exactly two distinct nondegenerate global maximizers. Off that curve the global maximizer is unique; at the endpoint its second and third derivatives vanish and fourth derivative is negative. Away from the curve and endpoint it is nondegenerate.

title: Multiple-spine change of measure for constant-rate branching
description: For rate-β branching with offspring A and moments m_j=EAʲ finite for1≤j≤k, start one ancestor with k marks. A particle carrying j marks moves by the original Markov motion, branches at rateβm_j with offspring law aʲP(A=a)/m_j, and each mark independently chooses a child uniformly. Unmarked particles retain the original branching law. The marked genealogical subtree is its skeleton.

title: Many-to-few lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
description: Let Q_k be the multiple-spine law with unchanged motion, m_j=EAʲ, and let D_s(v) count marks on a skeleton particle v alive at s. For nonnegative measurable F of k terminal particle positions (or their ancestral paths), E_P∑_{(u₁,…,u_k)∈N_tᵏ}F(u₁,…,u_k)=E_{Q_k}[F(ξ¹,…,ξᵏ)exp{β∫₀ᵗ∑_{v marked alive at s}(m_{D_s(v)}−1)ds}]. Offspring moments through k are finite; repeated labels are included. Killed marks contribute zero. This is the unchanged-motion specialization of the full Harris–Roberts lemma.

title: Population law of the binary Yule process
description: For one initial particle splitting into two at rateβ per particle without death, P(N_t=n)=e^{−βt}(1−e^{−βt})^{n−1} for n≥1. All integer moments are finite at every finite time.

title: Duhamel formula for an inhomogeneous semigroup equation
description: If T_t is a strongly continuous semigroup with generator A and u is a classical solution of u′=Au+f with suitably integrable continuous forcing, then u(t)=T_tu(0)+∫₀ᵗT_{t−s}f(s)ds. The integral is a Bochner integral.

title: Binomial theorem
description: For commuting elements a,b in a commutative ring and integer n≥0, (a+b)ⁿ=∑_{j=0}ⁿbinomial(n,j)aʲb^{n−j}.

title: Moment recursion for binary branching Markov processes
description: For binary rate-β branching with killed-motion semigroup P_tᴰ, set T_t=e^{βt}P_tᴰ and u_n(t,x)=E_x(∑_{v∈N_t}f(X_v(t)))ⁿ for bounded nonnegative f. Then u_n(t)=T_t(fⁿ)+β∑_{j=1}^{n−1}binomial(n,j)∫₀ᵗT_s[u_j(t−s)u_{n−j}(t−s)]ds. This includes repeated particle labels.

title: Maynard’s variational criterion for prime clusters
description: Let M_k be the supremum of (∑ᵢJ_i(F))/I(F) for nonzero real Riemann-integrable F supported on {t_i≥0,∑t_i≤1}, where I=∫F² and J_i=∫(∫F dt_i)². If primes have level of distribution θ>0, every admissible k-tuple has infinitely many translates containing at least ceil(θM_k/2) primes.

title: Maynard’s lower bound for the prime-cluster variational constant
description: For all sufficiently large k, the prime-cluster variational constant M_k satisfies M_k>log k−2loglog k−2.

title: Hardy–Littlewood asymptotic formula in Waring’s problem
description: For every k≥2 and all sufficiently large fixed s, the number R_{s,k}(n) of ordered representations of n as s positive kth powers is asymptotic to Γ(1+1/k)^s·S_{s,k}(n)·n^(s/k−1)/Γ(s/k). The singular series is ∑_{q≥1}∑_{(a,q)=1}(q⁻¹∑_{r=1}^q exp(2πiar^k/q))^s exp(−2πian/q), and is bounded below by a positive constant uniformly in n when s is sufficiently large.

title: Integral Miller basis for full-group elliptic modular forms
description: For each integral weight k, M_k(SL₂(Z)) has a basis f_j=q^j+O(q^d), 0≤j<d, with integer Fourier coefficients, where d=dim_C M_k. For even k≥0, d≤floor(k/12)+1; spaces of odd weight and weight2 are zero.

title: Kernel of the genus-two Witt operator modulo p≥5
description: For an even integer k≥0 and prime p≥5, the kernel of the reduced Witt restriction on full-group genus-two forms over Z_(p) is X₁₀ times the reduced weight-(k−10) space.

title: Nagaoka’s congruences for Igusa’s integral generators modulo2 and3
description: For p=2 or3, the reductions of all fourteen even-weight Igusa integral generators are explicit polynomials in X₁₀,Y₁₂,X₁₆. In particular X₄≡X₆≡1, X₁₂≡X₁₀, X₁₈≡X₁₆ and X₂₄≡X₁₀X₁₆. The complete finite identity list, with the distinct p=2 and p=3 higher-weight formulas, is fixed by the stated source locator.

title: First-order Malliavin Sobolev space on Wiener space
description: For1<p<∞, D¹,ᵖ is the completion of smooth cylindrical Wiener functionals in the norm(E|F|ᵖ+E‖DF‖_Hᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ, using the closed Malliavin derivative D and Cameron–Martin space H.

title: Parabolic Hörmander bracket condition for a diffusion
description: For smooth Stratonovich fields V₀,V₁,…,V_d, the noise fields V_i,i≥1, together with their iterated Lie brackets with V₀,…,V_d, span the spatial tangent space at every point. The drift field alone is not included as a generating direction.

title: Transport bound for a finite UFG bracket family
description: For bounded smooth UFG fields with generating brackets V_α and flow Jacobian J_t, each V_α(x) can be expressed as∑_βb_{βα}(t,x)J_t(x)^{-1}V_β(X_t^x). The finitely many coefficients b_{βα} have moments of every order bounded uniformly over x and bounded time intervals.

title: Preservation of full Hörmander rank for UFG diffusions
description: For bounded smooth UFG fields with finite bracket-generation level ℓ, let h(x) be the determinant of the Gram matrix formed from brackets of weighted length≤ℓ, excluding the drift alone. The solution started in E={h>0} remains in E at every fixed time almost surely. For p>1 and0≤t≤T, E[h(X_t^x)^{-p}]≤C_{p,T}h(x)^{-p}.

title: Hörmander smooth-density theorem for diffusions
description: For bounded smooth Stratonovich diffusion fields satisfying the parabolic Hörmander bracket condition, the transition law at positive time has a smooth density with respect to Lebesgue measure. A full-rank invariant open region may be used in place of the whole Euclidean space.

title: Gaussian upper bound for full-rank UFG transition densities
description: For bounded smooth UFG fields on ℝᴺ generated through weighted length ℓ, write h for their finite-bracket Gram determinant and E={h>0}. For0<t≤T and x,y∈E, the smooth transition density satisfies p_t(x,y)≤Ct^{−(N+1)ℓ/2}h(x)^{−2(N+1)ℓ}exp(−c|x−y|²/t). The same estimate holds with h(y) replacing h(x); C,c>0 may depend on the fields and T.

title: Malliavin integration by parts along UFG bracket directions
description: For bounded smooth UFG Stratonovich fields, a generated bracket V_α of weighted length |α|, and random weight Φ with uniformly bounded D¹,ᵖ norms for every p>1, there are weights H_α(Φ;t,x) with uniformly bounded Lᵖ norms on0<t≤T such that E[Φ(V_αf)(X_t^x)]=t^{−|α|/2}E[H_α(Φ;t,x)f(X_t^x)] for bounded smooth f. Constants depend on the fields, bracket and weight norms.

title: First and second noise-direction estimates for UFG diffusion semigroups
description: For bounded smooth UFG fields, P_tf(x)=Ef(X_t^x) and every noise field V_j,j≥1, there is C_T such that ‖V_jP_tf‖∞≤C_T‖∇f‖∞ and ‖V_j²P_tf‖∞≤C_Tt^{-1/2}‖∇f‖∞ for0<t≤T and smooth f with bounded first derivative.

title: Sobolev–Morrey bound for W¹,ᵖ on Euclidean space
description: If p>N, a function in W¹,ᵖ(ℝᴺ) has a bounded continuous representative with ‖f‖∞≤C‖f‖_{W¹,ᵖ}.

title: Gaussian exponential displacement moments for bounded-coefficient diffusions
description: For a Brownian diffusion with globally bounded drift and diffusion coefficients, for every T>0 there are c,C>0 such that sup_{x,0<t≤T}Eexp(c|X_t^x−x|²/t)≤C.

title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequality in L²
description: For a continuous local martingale M with M₀=0 and a stopping time T, E[M]_T≤E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E[M]_T, with expectations allowed infinite and [M] its quadratic variation. The finite case follows by localization.

title: Doob’s L² maximal inequality
description: For a right-continuous square-integrable martingale M on[0,T], E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E|M_T|².

title: Quadratic-variation isometry for continuous martingales
description: If M is a continuous square-integrable martingale with M₀=0, then E|M_T|²=E[M]_T for bounded stopping times T. Localized versions apply when the expectations are finite.

title: Quadratic covariation of Brownian coordinates
description: For coordinates of standard multidimensional Brownian motion, [B^i,B^j]_t=δ_{ij}t almost surely, simultaneously for all t≥0.

title: Itô isometry for Brownian integrals
description: For a predictable Brownian integrand H with E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds<∞, E|∫₀ᵀH_s dB_s|²=E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds, and the integral has mean zero.

title: Strong well-posedness of globally Lipschitz Brownian SDEs
description: If drift b and diffusion matrix σ are globally Lipschitz on ℝⁿ, then for each deterministic initial state and Brownian motion there is a pathwise unique adapted continuous strong solution of dX=b(X)dt+σ(X)dB, with finite second moments of its supremum on bounded time intervals.

title: Smooth stochastic flow for bounded smooth diffusion fields
description: For C_b∞ Stratonovich fields on ℝⁿ, the solution maps x↦X_t^x form a stochastic flow of C∞ diffeomorphisms, after choosing a suitable version. Their spatial derivatives and inverse Jacobians have all finite moments locally uniformly in time, uniformly in the starting point.

title: Completeness of Bochner Lᵖ spaces
description: If X is a Banach space and1≤p≤∞, the Bochner space Lᵖ(μ;X) is complete for its norm.

title: Completeness of continuous Banach-valued function spaces
description: For a compact metric space K and Banach space X, the continuous maps K→X form a Banach space for the supremum norm.

title: Weak Jacobi form
description: An integer-weight, nonnegative integer-index scalar Jacobi form with the usual modular and elliptic transformation laws, whose Fourier expansion at every cusp has n≥0 but may have negative discriminant 4mn−ℓ². This weakens the Fourier-support condition of a holomorphic Jacobi form.

title: Jacobi theta function with characteristics
description: For fixed real a,b, θ[a,b](τ,z)=∑_{n∈Z}exp(πi(n+a)²τ+2πi(n+a)(z+b)), with Im(τ)>0. The three even half-characteristics (1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2) give the standard θ₂,θ₃,θ₄ conventions.

title: Canonical weak Jacobi form φ₀,₁
description: The weight-zero, index-one weak Jacobi form φ₀,₁(τ,z)=4∑_{(a,b)=(1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2)}(θ[a,b](τ,z)/θ[a,b](τ,0))². It begins ζ⁻¹+10+ζ+O(q); its coefficient c(n,ℓ) depends only on 4n−ℓ².

title: Infinite product of complex numbers or functions
description: The limit of the finite partial products ∏_{j=1}^N a_j as N→∞, when it exists; for functions the mode of convergence is specified, such as locally uniform convergence on the stated domain. Formal products mean stabilization of each coefficient instead of analytic convergence.

title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product formulas for Igusa cusp forms
description: Write q=e^(2πiz₁), r=e^(2πiz₂), s=e^(2πiz₃), and let f(D) be the discriminant coefficients of φ₀,₁. The integrally normalized Igusa forms satisfy X₁₀=qrs∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(2f(4nm−l²)) and X₃₅=q²rs²(q−s)∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f₂(4nm−l²)), where f₂(N)=8f(4N)+2((−N/2)−1)f(N)+f(N/4), using the Kronecker symbol and f(N/4)=0 unless 4 divides N. Products range over n,m≥0, arbitrary l when n+m>0, and l<0 when n=m=0; they converge near the standard cusp.

title: Kronecker symbol with denominator2
description: For an integer a, (a/2)=0 if a is even, and (a/2)=(−1)^((a²−1)/8) if a is odd; equivalently it is 1 for a≡±1 modulo8 and −1 for a≡±3 modulo8.

title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product for the genus-two weight-five theta product
description: The genus-two modular form Δ₅, the normalized product of the ten even genus-two theta constants, has product (qrs)^(1/2)∏_(n,l,m)>0(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f(4nm−l²)), where f is the discriminant coefficient function of φ₀,₁.

title: Multiplicative Hecke operator on Siegel modular forms
description: For a finite double-coset correspondence ΓMΓ, the multiplicative transform of F is the product of its weight-slash transforms over left-coset representatives, with the corresponding weight and character. It contrasts with the additive sum defining an ordinary Hecke operator.

title: Humbert divisors of the Igusa cusp forms
description: On the genus-two Siegel modular variety, the weight-five even-theta product has simple divisor H₁, and the weight35 Igusa cusp form has divisor H₁+H₄ with multiplicity one on both Humbert surfaces.

title: Humbert surface in the genus-two Siegel modular variety
description: The image in Sp₄(Z)∖H₂ of the quadratic divisor a z₁+b z₂+c z₃+d(z₂²−z₁z₃)+e=0 with primitive integer coefficients and positive discriminant D=b²−4ac−4de; all such divisors of discriminant D give the Humbert surface H_D.

title: Divisor of a meromorphic function on a complex manifold
description: The locally finite formal sum of irreducible complex hypersurfaces weighted by the orders of zeros of a meromorphic function, negative for poles.

title: Koecher’s principle for Siegel modular forms
description: In genus g≥2, a holomorphic function on H_g obeying a Siegel modular transformation law for an arithmetic congruence group has the usual nonnegative cusp Fourier support, without an additional growth hypothesis.

title: Squarefree integer
description: A positive integer divisible by no square of a prime.

title: Gradient of a scalar function on Euclidean space
description: For differentiable f on an open subset of R^n, the vector ∇f=(∂₁f,…,∂ₙf), defined by its coordinate partial derivatives.

title: First variation of a functional
description: For a functional J on a space of functions, its first variation at u in the allowed direction φ is the derivative at t=0 of J(u+tφ), when it exists. A function is stationary if this derivative vanishes for every allowed variation.

title: Fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations
description: If a continuous real function g on an open Ω⊂R^n satisfies ∫gφ=0 for every smooth compactly supported real φ, then g=0 on Ω.

title: Chinese remainder theorem for integers
description: For pairwise coprime positive integers m₁,…,m_r and residues a_i modulo m_i, there is a unique residue modulo ∏m_i reducing to a_i modulo every m_i.

title: Multiple dense divisibility of integers
description: Fix y≥1. Every positive integer is 0-tuply y-densely divisible. Recursively n is i-tuply y-densely divisible if, for all j+k=i−1 and 1≤R≤yn, there is n=ab with R/y≤b≤R, where a is j-tuply and b is k-tuply y-densely divisible.

title: Polymath’s prime distribution to fourfold densely divisible moduli
description: If ϖ,δ>0 satisfy600ϖ+180δ<7, the Motohashi–Pintz–Zhang discrepancy estimate holds for squarefree4-tuply x^δ-densely divisible moduli q≤x^(1/2+2ϖ−ε), for every ε>0: uniformly over bounded prime sets I and a coprime to P_I, the sum over q dividing P_I of |Δ(Λ1_[x,2x];a mod q)| is O_A(x/(log x)^A). Here Δ subtracts the coprime-class mean.

title: Prime number theorem with de la Vallée Poussin’s error term
description: There is c>0 for which ψ(x)=x+O(x exp(−c√log x)) as x→∞, where ψ(x)=∑_{n≤x}Λ(n).

title: Bézout’s identity for integers
description: For integers a,b not both zero, there are integers u,v such that ua+vb=gcd(a,b).

title: Nonexplosion of finite-mean continuous-time Galton–Watson branching
description: For independent rate-β lifetimes and a finite-mean integer offspring law, a continuous-time Galton–Watson process started from finitely many individuals has finitely many individuals and branching events on each bounded time interval almost surely.

title: Poisson random measure
description: An integer-valued random measure N with intensity ν such that N(A) is Poisson with meanν(A) for every finite-intensity measurable set A, and counts on disjoint sets are independent.

title: Compensation formula for Poisson random measures
description: If N has intensity dt·ν(dz), then for every nonnegative predictable H, E∫H(t,z)N(dt,dz)=E∫H(t,z)dtν(dz). The predictable hypothesis refers to a filtration in which future Poisson increments are independent of the past.

title: Positive-power criterion for finite Markov chains
description: An irreducible finite transition matrix is aperiodic if and only if some positive integer power is entrywise strictly positive; then every sufficiently large power is entrywise positive.

title: Convergence to equilibrium for finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chains
description: Every finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chain has a unique strictly positive stationary law π, and Pⁿ(x,y)→π(y) for every pair of states, hence in total variation from every initial law.

title: Direct sum of abelian groups
description: For a family of abelian groups A_i, the subgroup of their Cartesian product consisting of tuples with finite support, with coordinatewise addition.

title: Nonnegative grading on a commutative ring
description: A decomposition R=⊕_{n≥0}R_n of its additive group such that R_mR_n⊆R_{m+n} and 1∈R_0. Multiplication is ordinarily commutative; this does not mean the sign rule sometimes called graded commutativity.

title: Least common multiple of integers
description: For nonzero integers a₁,…,a_r, the least positive integer divisible by every a_i.

title: Rational parametrization of the unit circle
description: The map t↦((1−t²)/(1+t²),2t/(1+t²)) from Q to rational points of x²+y²=1 other than (−1,0). Its inverse is t=y/(1+x); t∈(0,1) describes the positive quadrant after exchanging coordinates if desired.

title: Hille–Yosida theorem for contraction semigroups
description: A densely defined operator A on a Banach space generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup exactly when it is closed, every λ>0 belongs to its resolvent, and ‖(λI−A)^{-n}‖≤λ^{-n} for every integer n≥1. Its resolvent is the Laplace transform∫₀∞e^{-λt}T_tdt.

title: Completeness of Sobolev spaces
description: For integer k≥0 and1≤p≤∞, W^{k,p}(Ω) is a Banach space for the norm combining all weak-derivative Lᵖ norms. In particular W^{k,2} is Hilbert.

title: Perron theorem for compact positivity-improving self-adjoint operators
description: A nonzero compact self-adjoint nonnegative operator on L² that sends every nonzero nonnegative function to a strictly positive function has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction.

title: Regular symmetric Dirichlet form
description: A symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(E,m), where E is locally compact separable metric and m is a full-support Radon measure, is regular if its domain intersected with compactly supported continuous functions is dense both in the domain’s E₁ norm and in C_c(E) for the uniform norm.

title: Quasi-homeomorphism of Dirichlet spaces
description: A map between full nest unions of two Dirichlet spaces that restricts to a homeomorphism on each corresponding pair of closed nest sets, pushes one reference measure to the other, and identifies the two forms by pullback, including their domains.

title: Regular representation theorem for quasi-regular Dirichlet forms
description: Every quasi-regular Dirichlet form is quasi-homeomorphic to a regular Dirichlet form on a locally compact separable metric space; conversely such a quasi-homeomorphic image of a regular form is quasi-regular.

title: Hunt-process existence for regular symmetric Dirichlet forms
description: A regular symmetric Dirichlet form on a locally compact separable metric space with full-support Radon reference measure has an associated symmetric Hunt process, outside a properly exceptional set, whose transition semigroup agrees with the L² semigroup of the form.

title: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
description: A compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has an orthonormal basis consisting of eigenvectors together with a basis of its kernel; every nonzero eigenvalue has finite multiplicity and zero is the only possible accumulation point of nonzero eigenvalues.

title: Spectral theorem for bounded self-adjoint operators
description: A bounded self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has a unique projection-valued spectral measure, supported on its real spectrum, representing the operator and its bounded Borel functional calculus.

title: Polar decomposition of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
description: Every bounded operator J between Hilbert spaces has a factorization J=U(J*J)¹ᐟ² with a partial isometry U whose initial space is the closure of the range of J*. Equivalently J=(JJ*)¹ᐟ²U.

title: Riesz representation theorem for Hilbert-space functionals
description: Every bounded linear functional ℓ on a real or complex Hilbert space H is uniquely of the form x↦⟨x,y⟩ for some y∈H, with ‖ℓ‖=‖y‖; the inner product is linear in its first argument, so in the complex case y depends conjugate-linearly on ℓ.

title: Lax–Milgram theorem over real Hilbert spaces
description: If a bounded bilinear form a on a real Hilbert space H is coercive, a(u,u)≥c‖u‖² for c>0, then for every bounded linear functional ℓ there is a unique u∈H with a(u,v)=ℓ(v) for all v∈H.

title: Rellich compactness of H₀¹ into L² on a bounded domain
description: For a bounded Euclidean domain, the inclusion H₀¹(Ω)→L²(Ω) is compact.

title: Regularity of Dirichlet elliptic eigenfunctions
description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain, Dirichlet eigenfunctions of the real symmetric uniformly elliptic divergence-form operator L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth real coefficients and no zeroth-order term are smooth in the interior, bounded, and extend continuously by zero to the boundary.

title: Strong maximum principle for uniformly elliptic equations
description: For L=div(A∇)+b·∇+c with uniformly elliptic A, locally bounded lower-order coefficients and c≤0, a nonnegative weak supersolution Lu≤0 on a connected domain is either positive almost everywhere or identically zero.

title: Eigenvalue of a densely defined operator
description: For A:D(A)⊆H→H, a scalar λ is an eigenvalue if there is a nonzero v∈D(A) with Av=λv. The operator need not be bounded or defined on all of H.

title: Spectral decomposition of a bounded-domain Dirichlet elliptic operator
description: For the real divergence-form operator L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic coefficients and no zeroth-order term, on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain, the L² realization has eigenvalues0<λ₁<λ₂≤⋯→∞ and a real orthonormal eigenbasis φ_n. The principal eigenvalue is simple with φ₁>0 inside. Eigenfunctions are smooth inside and continuous by zero at the boundary, and P_tᴰf=∑_ne^{−λ_nt}⟨f,φ_n⟩φ_n in L².

title: Spectral characterization of H₀¹ and the Dirichlet Laplacian domain
description: Let λ_n,φ_n be Dirichlet eigenpairs of−½Δ on a bounded C¹ domain. A function f∈L² is in H₀¹ exactly when∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞, and then∫|∇f|²=2∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|². For f∈H₀¹, its weak Laplacian lies in L² exactly when∑λ_n²|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞. No global H² boundary regularity is asserted.

title: First Dirichlet spectral gap
description: For a bounded-domain self-adjoint Dirichlet operator with ordered eigenvalues λ₁<λ₂≤⋯, the first spectral gap is λ₂−λ₁.

title: Intrinsic ultracontractivity on bounded Lipschitz domains
description: The killed symmetric uniformly elliptic diffusion semigroup on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain with smooth coefficients is intrinsically ultracontractive: for each t>0 its kernel satisfies p_t(x,y)≤C_tφ₁(x)φ₁(y).

title: Uniform exponential mixing of the ground-state-transformed Dirichlet diffusion
description: For a bounded connected Lipschitz domain and a smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic killed diffusion, let φ be its positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction and γ=λ₂−λ₁. Its ground-state transition density K_t satisfies sup_{x,y}|K_t(x,y)/φ(y)²−1|≤C_εe^{−γt} for every t≥ε>0.

title: Rank of a linear map
description: The dimension of the image of a linear map.

title: Moore–Penrose inverse of a real matrix
description: For a real matrix A, its Moore–Penrose inverse A† is the matrix satisfying AA†A=A, A†AA†=A†, (AA†)ᵀ=AA† and (A†A)ᵀ=A†A. For full column rank, A†=(AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ.

title: Induced Riemannian metric of an embedded surface
description: An embedded smooth surface inherits the Euclidean inner product on each tangent plane; in a chart m its metric matrix is g_{ij}=∂ᵢm·∂ⱼm.

title: Unit normal field on an embedded surface
description: A smooth map n:M→S² perpendicular to T_xM at every x. A global choice fixes an orientation; such a choice is an additional assumption when it does not exist globally.

title: Shape operator of an oriented embedded surface
description: With a chosen unit normal field n, the shape operator is S_x(v)=−dn_x(v) on T_xM. This uses the −dn sign convention.

title: Source condition for a differentiable quadratic Tikhonov penalty
description: Let F:X→Y be bounded linear between real Hilbert spaces and R a differentiable quadratic penalty. The variational source condition at x† is R′(x†)=F′w for some w∈Y*, where F′w=w∘F and R′(x†)∈X*. Under Hilbert-space identifications this is the usual adjoint range condition, with constant factors absorbed in w.

title: C² embedded surface in ℝ³
description: A subset of ℝ³ that locally, after a rigid coordinate change, is the graph of a twice continuously differentiable real function of two variables.

title: Support of a distribution
description: The complement of the largest open set on which the distribution vanishes on every smooth compactly supported test function.

title: Hyperplane trace operator for a function space
description: The restriction map f(x₁,…,x_n)↦f(x₁,…,x_{n−1},0), initially on smooth functions; a trace on a larger function space is a continuous extension of this map when such an extension exists.

title: Hölder inequality in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
description: For measurable p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1/p(x)+1/p′(x)=1, ∫|fg|≤2∥f∥_{p(·)}∥g∥_{p′(·)}.

title: Minkowski inequality for Lᵖ norms
description: For 1≤p≤∞ and f,g∈Lᵖ of a measure space, ∥f+g∥_p≤∥f∥_p+∥g∥_p.

title: Fourier inversion theorem on Schwartz space
description: With f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e^{−ix·ξ}dx, every Schwartz function satisfies f(x)=(2π)^{−n}∫f̂(ξ)e^{ix·ξ}dξ, and the Fourier transform maps Schwartz space continuously onto itself.

title: Calderón reproducing formula for an inhomogeneous dyadic resolution
description: Let φ₀,ψ₀ be fixed Schwartz kernels and, for j≥1, let φ_j,ψ_j be the standard dyadic dilations of fixed Schwartz kernels with annular Fourier support, with φ̂₀ψ̂₀+∑_{j≥1}φ̂_jψ̂_j=1 and the high-frequency terms supported in dyadic annuli. Then f=ψ₀*φ₀*f+∑_{j≥1}ψ_j*φ_j*f in S′ for every tempered distribution f.

title: Non-extreme scalar Schur function
description: A holomorphic b on the unit disk with ∥b∥∞≤1 that is not an extreme point of the closed unit ball of H∞, regarded as a real convex set.

title: Pythagorean pair for a non-extreme scalar Schur function
description: For a non-extreme b, a pair (b,a) has a∈H∞ outer, a(0)>0, and |a|²+|b|²=1 almost everywhere on the unit circle.

title: Partial isometry between Hilbert spaces
description: A bounded linear operator that preserves norms on the orthogonal complement of its kernel.

title: Hilbert space structure on an operator range
description: For a bounded map A:H→K between Hilbert spaces, give Ran A the norm ∥y∥=inf{∥x∥:Ax=y}, equivalently transport the norm from (ker A)⊥ through A. This norm can differ from the ambient K norm.

title: Douglas range inclusion and factorization theorem
description: For bounded maps A:H₁→H₀ and B:H₂→H₀ between Hilbert spaces, Ran A⊆Ran B, AA*≤λBB* for some λ≥0, and A=BC for some bounded C are equivalent. The least possible ∥C∥ is the square root of the least such λ.

title: Outer function with prescribed boundary modulus
description: If w≥0 belongs to L² of the unit circle and log w∈L¹, there is a unique outer a∈H² with a(0)>0 and |a|=w almost everywhere. If w≤1 then a∈H∞ with norm at most one.

title: Poisson formula for the logarithm of an outer function
description: For a nonzero outer a∈H² of the unit disk, log|a(z)|=∫_T P_z(ζ)log|a*(ζ)|dm(ζ), where P_z(ζ)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|² and m is normalized arc measure. In particular |a(0)|=exp∫log|a*|dm.

title: Logarithmic boundary integrability of nonzero Hardy H² functions
description: A nonzero f∈H² has log|f*|∈L¹ on the unit circle, and log|f(0)|≤∫log|f*|dm when f(0)≠0, with m probability-normalized arc measure.

title: Boundary norm formula for Hardy H∞
description: For bounded holomorphic f on the disk, its radial boundary function f* exists almost everywhere and sup_D|f|=ess sup_T|f*|.

title: Extreme-point criterion for the closed unit ball of H∞
description: A scalar Schur function b is non-extreme exactly when log(1−|b*|²) is integrable on the unit circle.

title: Sarason’s Toeplitz characterization of H(b) for non-extreme b
description: For a Pythagorean pair (b,a), f∈H² lies in H(b) exactly when T_{b̄}f=T_{ā}g for some g∈H². That g is unique and ∥f∥²_{H(b)}=∥f∥²_{H²}+∥g∥²_{H²}.

title: Polynomial density in H(b) for non-extreme b
description: If b is a non-extreme scalar Schur function, analytic polynomials are dense in its de Branges–Rovnyak space H(b).

title: Nowhere dense subset of a topological space
description: A subset whose closure has empty interior.

title: Meagre subset of a topological space
description: A countable union of nowhere dense subsets.

title: Residual subset of a topological space
description: A subset whose complement is meagre.

title: Baire topological space
description: A topological space in which every countable intersection of dense open subsets is dense.

title: Closed range of a bounded linear operator
description: A bounded linear operator has closed range when its image is a closed subset of its codomain.

title: Symmetric measurable function on a finite product space
description: A measurable function f(x₁,…,x_N) unchanged by every permutation of its N arguments.

title: Counting measure
description: The measure on all subsets of a set that assigns a finite set its cardinality and an infinite set the value∞.

title: ℓᵖ space of scalar sequences
description: For1≤p≤∞, ℓᵖ is Lᵖ on the natural numbers with counting measure: p-summable scalar sequences for finite p and bounded sequences for p=∞.

title: Banach space c₀ of null sequences
description: The scalar sequences tending to zero, with the supremum norm.

title: Domination of one basic sequence by another
description: A basic sequence (x_n) dominates (y_n) if some C satisfies ∥∑a_n y_n∥≤C∥∑a_n x_n∥ for every finitely supported scalar sequence (a_n).

title: Equivalent basic sequences
description: Two basic sequences are equivalent if each dominates the other; equivalently their coordinate correspondence extends to a Banach-space isomorphism of their closed spans.

title: Subsymmetric Schauder basis
description: An unconditional Schauder basis equivalent to each of its subsequences.

title: C*-seminorm on a complex *-algebra
description: A seminorm γ on a complex *-algebra satisfying γ(ab)≤γ(a)γ(b) and γ(a*a)=γ(a)². It can vanish on nonzero elements and does not imply completeness.

title: Positive linear functional on a complex *-algebra
description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for all a∈A; neither a C*-norm on A nor continuity is assumed.

title: Trace-class operator on a Hilbert space
description: A bounded operator T for which |T|=(T*T)¹ᐟ² is a positive trace-class operator, equivalently its singular values are summable.

title: Origin-symmetric generalized zonoid
description: An origin-symmetric convex body K that is a Minkowski difference of origin-symmetric zonoids: there are such zonoids L,M with K+M=L, equivalently h_K=h_L−h_M.

title: Difference body of a convex body
description: The origin-symmetric body K−K=K+(−K), where−K={−x:x∈K}. Some sources use the normalized difference body½(K−K).

title: Riemann integral of a continuous Banach-valued function
description: For continuous f:[a,b]→X with X Banach, its integral is the norm limit of tagged sums ∑f(t_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}) as the partition mesh tends to zero.

title: Norm bound for a Banach-valued Riemann integral
description: For continuous f from a compact real interval into a Banach space, ∥∫f(t)dt∥≤∫∥f(t)∥dt.

title: Continuity of holomorphic functional calculus under compact uniform convergence
description: If f_n→f uniformly on compact subsets of a common neighborhood of σ(T), for a bounded Banach-space operator T, then f_n(T)→f(T) in operator norm.

title: Test-function topology on C_c^∞ of an open Euclidean set
description: The finest locally convex topology making every inclusion D_K→C_c^∞(Ω) continuous, where D_K consists of smooth functions supported in a fixed compact K⊂Ω and has the seminorms max_{|α|≤m}sup|∂^αφ|.

title: Smooth real manifold
description: A Hausdorff second-countable topological space with charts to open subsets of R^n whose transition maps are smooth. Smooth functions and maps are those whose expressions in these charts are smooth.

title: Real Lie group
description: A group that is a smooth real manifold, with smooth multiplication and inversion.

title: Derivation of an algebra
description: A linear map D:A→A on an associative algebra over a field satisfying D(ab)=D(a)b+aD(b).

title: Smooth vector field on a manifold
description: An R-linear derivation of the algebra C∞(M) of smooth real functions on a smooth manifold M. In local coordinates it acts as ∑_i X^i(x)∂_i with smooth coefficient functions.

title: Lie algebra over a field
description: A vector space with a bilinear bracket [x,y] satisfying [x,x]=0 and [x,[y,z]]+[y,[z,x]]+[z,[x,y]]=0.

title: Lie algebra of a real Lie group
description: The real vector space of left-invariant smooth vector fields on a real Lie group, with bracket [X,Y] acting on smooth functions as X∘Y−Y∘X. It is identified with the tangent space at the identity.

title: Universal enveloping algebra of a Lie algebra
description: The unital associative algebra U(g) with a linear map i:g→U(g) satisfying i([x,y])=i(x)i(y)−i(y)i(x), universal for such maps from g into associative algebras. Its universal property does not include an unproved assertion of injectivity.

title: Center of an associative algebra
description: The subalgebra of elements commuting with every element of the associative algebra.

title: Maximal compact subgroup of a Lie group
description: A compact subgroup of a real Lie group maximal among its compact subgroups under inclusion.

title: K-finite function under right translation
description: For a subgroup K of G, a complex function f on G is K-finite if the functions x↦f(xk), k∈K, span a finite-dimensional complex vector space. In automorphic applications K is compact.

title: Z(g)-finite smooth function on a Lie group
description: A smooth complex function f on a real Lie group is Z(g)-finite when the span of zf, for z in the center of U(g⊗_R C), is finite-dimensional. The action differentiates right translations and extends to the enveloping algebra.

title: Locally constant function
description: A function that is constant on some open neighbourhood of each point of its domain.

title: Restricted tensor product of vector spaces
description: For vector spaces V_i with specified nonzero reference vectors v_i, the vector space spanned by tensors ⊗_i w_i for which w_i=v_i outside a finite set, subject to the usual multilinear relations. This is the algebraic restricted tensor product, without a Hilbert completion.

title: Normalized local multiplicative norm on a number field
description: At a real place use the usual absolute value, at a complex place use the square of the usual complex modulus, and at a finite place v use |x|_v=(#k_v)^(−ord_v(x)), with |0|_v=0. The complex normalization is multiplicative but need not satisfy the ordinary triangle inequality.

title: Matrix height on an adelic linear algebraic group
description: Fix a faithful F-algebraic representation ρ of G. For g=(g_v), take H(g)=∏_v max(1,max_(i,j)|ρ(g_v)_(ij)|_v,max_(i,j)|ρ(g_v⁻¹)_(ij)|_v), using normalized local multiplicative norms. Almost all factors are1; equivalent faithful choices give comparable polynomial growth conditions.

title: Moderate growth of an adelic function
description: A function f on G(A_F) has moderate growth if |f(g)|≤C H(g)^N for some constants C,N>0 and a fixed faithful adelic matrix height H. Uniform moderate growth requires a common N for all derivatives from U(g_∞⊗C), with constants allowed to depend on the derivative.

title: Automorphic form on a reductive group over a number field
description: A complex function on G(A_F) for a connected reductive F-group, smooth at infinity and right invariant under an open compact subgroup at the finite places, left G(F)-invariant, of moderate growth, K∞-finite for a chosen maximal compact subgroup, and Z(g_∞)-finite.

title: Unitary operator on a complex Hilbert space
description: A surjective complex linear map preserving the inner product.

title: Unitary representation of a topological group
description: A group homomorphism π from a topological group to the unitary operators of a complex Hilbert space, strongly continuous in the sense that g↦π(g)v is norm-continuous for each vector v.

title: Irreducible unitary representation
description: A nonzero unitary representation with no closed invariant complex linear subspace other than0 and the whole Hilbert space.

title: Discrete subgroup of a locally compact group
description: A subgroup whose induced topology is discrete; equivalently the identity is isolated in the subgroup.

title: Quotient Haar measure for unimodular groups
description: For a closed unimodular subgroup H of a unimodular locally compact group G with fixed Haar measures, the right G-invariant measure on H∖G characterized by ∫_G f(g)dg=∫_(H∖G)∫_H f(hg)dh d[g] for compactly supported continuous f.

title: L²-space on an automorphic quotient
description: Complex square-integrable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality on Γ∖G, for a discrete subgroup Γ of a unimodular locally compact group G and the quotient Haar measure; the inner product is ∫_(Γ∖G)f·conj(h).

title: Cuspidal L²-space of a reductive group
description: The closed subspace of L²(G(F)∖G(A_F)¹) generated by the square-integrable smooth cuspidal automorphic forms, with the right regular unitary action. It is the Hilbert realization of the cuspidal spectrum.

title: Kernel of an integral operator
description: For a measure space, a measurable function K(x,y) representing an operator by (Tf)(x)=∫K(x,y)f(y)dμ(y), on the specified class of functions where the expression is defined. A square-integrable kernel is an element of L² of the product measure space.

title: Convolution of functions on a locally compact group
description: With a chosen left Haar measure, (f*g)(x)=∫_G f(y)g(y⁻¹x)dy when the integral exists, in particular for compactly supported continuous functions. The order matters for noncommutative groups.

title: Integrated operator of a unitary representation
description: For f∈L¹(G), the bounded operator π(f) determined weakly by ⟨π(f)v,w⟩=∫_G f(g)⟨π(g)v,w⟩dg. This uses a fixed Haar measure and a unitary representation of a locally compact group.

title: Tightness of a probability measure on a Polish space
description: Every Borel probability measure on a Polish space is tight: for every ε>0 some compact set has probability at least1−ε.

title: Weak compactness of probabilities on a compact metric space
description: The Borel probability measures on a compact metric space form a compact metrizable space for weak convergence; in particular every sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence.

title: Riesz–Markov representation on a compact space
description: Every positive linear functional on the continuous real functions on a compact Hausdorff space is integration against a unique finite regular Borel measure.

title: Separability of continuous functions on a compact metric space
description: For a compact metric space K, the Banach space C(K) with supremum norm is separable.

title: Total variation distance between probability measures
description: For probability measures μ,ν on the same measurable space, d_TV(μ,ν)=sup_{A measurable}|μ(A)−ν(A)|. This convention takes values in[0,1]; the total variation norm of μ−ν is twice this distance.

title: Interlacing and positive partial fractions
description: If p,q are monic real polynomials of degrees d,d−1 with real roots weakly interlacing, then after cancellation q/p has only simple real poles and a partial-fraction expansion∑_jc_j/(z−r_j), with c_j≥0. A denominator root of multiplicity m cancels at least m−1 times. Conversely such a ratio gives weak interlacing after reinserting common real factors.

title: Basis of a free module
description: A family (e_i) in a module over a commutative ring such that every element is a unique finite linear combination of the e_i with coefficients in that ring. A module with such a family is free.

title: Integral basis of a number field
description: A finite Z-module basis of the ring of integers O_F: every algebraic integer in F is a unique integer linear combination of the basis elements.

title: Trace in a finite field extension
description: For a finite field extension L/K and a∈L, Tr_(L/K)(a) is the trace of the K-linear multiplication map x↦ax on L.

title: Discriminant of a number field
description: For an integral basis ω₁,…,ω_n of F, the integer d_F=det(Tr_(F/Q)(ω_iω_j))_(i,j). A change of integral basis leaves this determinant unchanged.

title: Algebraic character of an affine algebraic group
description: A morphism of algebraic groups G→G_m over the specified field. Characters form an abelian group by pointwise multiplication.

title: Geometric character lattice of a reductive group
description: For a connected reductive F-group, X*(G)=Hom_(Fsep-groups)(G_Fsep,G_m) with pointwise multiplication and its natural absolute-Galois action. It is a finitely generated free abelian group; its fixed elements are the F-rational characters.

title: Idele group of a number field
description: The restricted product ∏′_v F_v× with respect to O_v× at finite places. As a group it is the unit group of the adele ring, but its restricted-product topology is specified independently rather than taken as the subspace topology from A_F.

title: Idelic norm
description: For an idele a=(a_v), |a|_A=∏_v|a_v|_v using the normalized local multiplicative norms; almost all factors are1. This is a continuous homomorphism A_F×→R_{>0}.

title: Galois field extension
description: An algebraic field extension that is both normal and separable.

title: Artin representation of a number field
description: A finite-dimensional complex representation of the absolute Galois group of a number field that is continuous and has finite image, equivalently one factoring through the Galois group of a finite Galois extension.

title: Decomposition group at a prime of a Galois extension
description: For a finite Galois extension L/F and a prime w above v, the subgroup D_w⊂Gal(L/F) of automorphisms preserving w.

title: Inertia group at a prime of a Galois extension
description: The subgroup I_w of the decomposition group consisting of automorphisms acting trivially on the residue field at w.

title: Quotient of a group by a normal subgroup
description: For a normal subgroup H of G, the cosets G/H form a group under (gH)(g′H)=gg′H.

title: Frobenius element at a prime of a Galois extension
description: The element of D_w/I_w acting on the residue extension by x↦x^(#k_v). At an unramified prime it gives a conjugacy class in Gal(L/F), independently of the chosen w above v.

title: Fixed vector subspace of a group representation
description: For a representation π on V and a subgroup H, the subspace V^H={v:π(h)v=v for every h∈H}. This means pointwise fixed vectors, not merely an invariant subspace.

title: Meromorphic function of one complex variable
description: A function on a complex domain locally expressible as a quotient of holomorphic functions with denominator not identically zero; zeros of the denominator give poles after common factors cancel.

title: Meromorphic continuation
description: A meromorphic function on a larger connected complex domain that agrees with a given function on its original open domain.

title: Artin L-function
description: For an Artin representation ρ factoring through Gal(L/F), the Euler product over finite places L(s,ρ)=∏_v det(1−ρ(Frob_w)(#k_v)^(−s)|V^(I_w))^(−1), initially for Re(s)>1, together with its meromorphic continuation. The local factor uses inertia-fixed vectors, so ramified places are included.

title: Exterior power of a module over a commutative ring
description: The module Λ^n_R M equipped with the universal alternating R-multilinear map M^n→Λ^n_R M; equivalently the corresponding quotient of the tensor power by tensors with repeated entries. This is the alternating quotient convention, not the anti-invariant tensor submodule.

title: Kähler differentials of an algebra
description: For a commutative F-algebra A, the A-module Ω_(A/F) generated by symbols da, a∈A, subject to additivity, F-linearity and d(ab)=a·db+b·da.

title: Lie algebra of an affine algebraic group
description: For a coordinate Hopf algebra A with counit ε, the F-vector space of linear maps D:A→F satisfying D(ab)=ε(a)D(b)+ε(b)D(a). Extend them to invariant derivations using the coproduct; their commutator induces the Lie bracket.

title: Invariant gauge form on a smooth affine algebraic group
description: A nowhere-zero left-invariant algebraic differential form ω of degree d=dim_F Lie(G): in coordinates it is an element of Λ^d Ω_(O(G)/F) whose value at every geometric point is nonzero. It is defined over F, and its invariant choices differ by F×.

title: Analytic manifold over a local field
description: A Hausdorff topological space with charts to open subsets of K^n, for a local field K, whose transition functions are locally given by convergent K-power series. Over R this means real analytic, over C complex analytic, and over a nonarchimedean field its usual convergent power-series notion.

title: Local measure defined by an algebraic gauge form
description: On the local-field points of a smooth algebraic group, write an invariant gauge form in analytic coordinates as ω=f(x)dx₁∧…∧dx_d and use |f(x)|_v times product additive Haar measure. For the number-field standard convention take vol(O_v)=1 at finite places, dx over R, and2 dxdy over C.

title: Product formula for a number field
description: For every nonzero a in a number field F, ∏_v|a|_v=1 using normalized local multiplicative norms at every finite and infinite place. Only finitely many factors differ from1.

title: Norm in a finite field extension
description: For a finite field extension L/K, N_(L/K)(a) is the determinant of the K-linear multiplication map x↦ax on L.

title: Compatibility of field norm with normalized place norms
description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields and every place v of K, ∏_(w|v)|a|_w=|N_(L/K)(a)|_v for all a∈L×.

title: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic
description: Every integer n≥2 factors as a product of primes uniquely up to ordering.

title: Real cosine function
description: For real t, cos(t) is the real part of exp(it).

title: Hermitian angle between nonzero complex vectors
description: For nonzero vectors x,y in a complex inner-product space, their Hermitian angle is the unique θ∈[0,π/2] with cos θ=|⟨x,y⟩|/(∥x∥∥y∥).

title: Uniformly continuous map between metric spaces
description: A map f:X→Y between metric spaces such that for every ε>0 some δ>0 satisfies d_Y(f(x),f(y))<ε whenever d_X(x,y)<δ. The same δ works at every point.

title: Heine–Cantor theorem
description: A continuous map from a compact metric space into a metric space is uniformly continuous.

title: Sequential characterization of compact metric spaces
description: A metric space is compact exactly when every sequence has a convergent subsequence with limit in the space.

title: Density approximation for the weighted generalized-mean integrability criterion
description: Let (Λ,μ) be a nonzero σ-finite measure space and N≥2. Symmetric probability densities P on Λᴺ can be approximated in L¹ by strictly positive symmetric densities Q for which Q(·,x)≥γ(x)Q_(N−1) almost everywhere for almost every x in a positive-measure set, with γ(x)>0 and Q_(N−1) the marginal. If 0<μ(Λ)<∞, such densities contain an open dense subset of the bounded symmetric probability densities in the L∞ topology.

title: Minimum attainment for lower semicontinuous functions on compact sets
description: A lower semicontinuous function from a nonempty compact space into (−∞,∞] attains its infimum.

title: Malliavin smooth Wiener functional
description: A Wiener functional is Malliavin smooth if it belongs to D^{k,p} for every integer k≥0 and every1<p<∞; here D^{k,p} is the completion of smooth cylindrical functionals in the Lᵖ norms of the functional and its first k Malliavin derivatives.

title: Malliavin criterion for a smooth density
description: If an ℝⁿ-valued Wiener functional F is Malliavin smooth and its Malliavin covariance Γ is invertible almost surely with E‖Γ⁻¹‖ᵖ<∞ for every p>1, then its law has a C∞ Lebesgue density.

title: Norris’s lemma for continuous semimartingales
description: Let Z_t=Z₀+∫₀ᵗA_sds+∫₀ᵗB_sdW_s on[0,1], with adapted A,B whose1/3-Hölder norms have every finite moment. There is r>0 such that for every p>0, P(‖Z‖∞≤ε and max(‖A‖∞,‖B‖∞)>εʳ)≤C_pεᵖ for0<ε≤1.

title: Small-ball estimate for the reduced Hörmander covariance
description: For bounded smooth Stratonovich fields satisfying the parabolic Hörmander condition, with flow Jacobian J and noise matrix V, C_t=∫₀ᵗJ_s⁻¹V(X_s)V(X_s)ᵀ(J_s⁻¹)ᵀds satisfies sup_{|η|=1}P(ηᵀC_tη<ε)≤C_{p,t,x}εᵖ for every p>0,t>0 and initial point x.

title: Kusuoka’s Malliavin control estimates for UFG brackets
description: For bounded smooth UFG fields and a generating bracket V_α of weighted length |α|, there is a Cameron–Martin-valued random control u_α(t,x) with D_{u_α}f(X_t^x)=(V_αf)(X_t^x), and sup_{x,0<t≤T}t^{|α|/2}‖u_α(t,x)‖_{D^{k,p}(H)}<∞ for every integer k≥0,p>1. This need not invert the full spatial covariance.

title: Sobolev bound for the Skorokhod divergence
description: For1<p<∞, the Skorokhod divergence on Wiener space extends to a bounded map D^{1,p}(H)→Lᵖ: ‖δu‖_p≤C_p‖u‖_{D^{1,p}(H)}.

title: Kolmogorov continuity criterion
description: If a real-valued random field on[0,1]ᵈ satisfies E|X_x−X_y|ᵖ≤C|x−y|^{d+αp} for p>0,α>0, then it has a modification with locally β-Hölder paths for every0<β<α.

title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequalities
description: For each p>0 there are0<c_p≤C_p<∞ such that every real continuous local martingale M starting at zero satisfies c_p E[M]_T^{p/2}≤E sup_{t≤T}|M_t|ᵖ≤C_p E[M]_T^{p/2}, with extended expectations and stopping times T.

title: Real implicit function theorem
description: If a Cᵏ map F:U⊆ℝⁿ×ℝᵐ→ℝᵐ, k≥1, vanishes at(a,b) and its derivative in the second variable is invertible there, then near(a,b) the zero set of F is uniquely the graph of a Cᵏ map y=g(x).

title: Automorphism of an affine algebraic group
description: An isomorphism G→G of algebraic groups over the specified field; equivalently an invertible endomorphism of its coordinate Hopf algebra.

title: Involution of an algebraic group
description: An algebraic-group automorphism σ satisfying σ²=id. In involution setups the identity automorphism is allowed unless order exactly two is required.

title: Fixed subgroup of an algebraic-group involution
description: The closed subgroup G^σ whose R-points are {g∈G(R):σ(g)=g} for each algebra over the ground field.

title: Diagonalizable linear endomorphism
description: A linear endomorphism of a finite-dimensional vector space admitting a basis of eigenvectors over its ground field. Diagonalizability over an algebraic closure is specified separately.

title: Semisimple element of an affine algebraic group
description: An element whose image in a faithful finite-dimensional algebraic representation is diagonalizable over an algebraic closure. This property is independent of the faithful representation; that independence is a theorem, rather than an additional part of the definition.

title: Twisted centralizer in an algebraic group
description: For an automorphism τ of G, a τ-stable closed subgroup H⊂G and δ∈G(k), C^τ_(H,δ) is the k-subgroup with R-points {x∈H(R):xδτ(x)⁻¹=δ}. The ambient H is part of the specification.

title: Center of an affine algebraic group
description: The closed subgroup Z(G) whose elements commute with every element after every extension of the ground algebra. Over a characteristic-zero field it is equivalently the closed subgroup whose geometric points form the center of G over an algebraic closure.

title: Identity component of an affine algebraic group
description: The connected component containing the identity, with its induced closed subgroup structure. In coordinate terms over an algebraic closure it is the factor of the coordinate algebra selected by the primitive idempotent whose value at the identity is1; this component descends to the ground field.

title: Quotient of an affine algebraic group by a normal subgroup
description: For a smooth affine group G over a characteristic-zero field and a closed normal subgroup N, G/N is the affine algebraic group with surjective quotient homomorphism G→G/N, geometric kernel N, and universal factorization property for algebraic homomorphisms killing N. Its geometric points are the cosets G(k̄)/N(k̄); over the ground field surjectivity on rational points is not asserted.

title: Double coset of two subgroups
description: For subgroups H,K⊂G, the double coset HgK={hgk:h∈H,k∈K}; H∖G/K denotes the partition into these subsets.

title: Relative stabilizer for two algebraic involutions
description: For involutions σ,θ of an affine group G and γ∈G(k), the k-group G_γ^(σθ) has R-points {(x,y)∈G^σ(R)×G^θ(R):x⁻¹γy=γ}. It is the stabilizer of γ under the left-right action.

title: Fundamental theorem for Banach-valued Sobolev functions
description: If u and its weak time derivative u′ belong to L¹(0,T;X) for a Banach space X, then u has an absolutely continuous representative satisfying u(t)−u(s)=∫_s^tu′(r)dr.

title: Ehrling’s lemma
description: If X₀ embeds compactly into a Banach space X and X embeds continuously into X₁, then for every ε>0 there is C_ε with ‖v‖_X≤ε‖v‖_{X₀}+C_ε‖v‖_{X₁} for all v∈X₀.

title: Sobolev inequality on Euclidean space
description: For1≤p<d and p*=dp/(d−p), every u∈W¹,ᵖ(ℝᵈ) satisfies ‖u‖_{p*}≤C_{d,p}‖∇u‖_p.

title: Sobolev extension theorem for Lipschitz domains
description: A bounded Lipschitz domain Ω⊂ℝᵈ admits, for each integer k≥1 and1<p<∞, a bounded linear extension E:W^{k,p}(Ω)→W^{k,p}(ℝᵈ) with Eu=u almost everywhere on Ω.

title: Morrey’s inequality on Euclidean space
description: For p>d, every u∈W¹,ᵖ(ℝᵈ) has a representative with |u(x)−u(y)|≤C|x−y|^{1−d/p}‖∇u‖_p for all x,y∈ℝᵈ.

title: Calderón–Zygmund Dirichlet estimate on a C¹,¹ domain
description: For a bounded C¹,¹ domain Ω and1<p<∞, every u∈W²,ᵖ(Ω)∩W₀¹,ᵖ(Ω) satisfies ‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}≤C(‖Δu‖_p+‖u‖_p). The constant is uniform under domain approximations with uniformly controlled C¹,¹ charts.

title: Calderón–Zygmund estimate for the half-space Dirichlet Laplacian
description: For1<p<∞ and smooth u compactly supported in the closed half-space with u=0 on its boundary, ‖D²u‖_p≤C_p‖Δu‖_p. The same estimate holds for constant symmetric uniformly elliptic operators after a boundary-preserving linear change of coordinates.

title: Interpolation between first and second Sobolev derivatives
description: On a bounded C¹,¹ domain, for1<p<∞ and ε>0, ‖∇u‖_p≤ε‖D²u‖_p+C_ε‖u‖_p for u∈W²,ᵖ.

title: Rellich compactness in the same Sobolev exponent
description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain and1<p<∞, W^{k,p}(Ω) embeds compactly into W^{k−1,p}(Ω) for every integer k≥1.

title: Smooth Dirichlet solvability for Poisson’s equation
description: On a bounded smooth Euclidean domain, smooth right-hand side f and zero boundary values have a unique solution of−Δu=f smooth up to the boundary.

title: Adapted stochastic process
description: A process X_t is adapted to a filtration(F_t) if each X_t is F_t-measurable.

title: Riemann–Stieltjes integral
description: For continuous real f and a real bounded-variation function g on[a,b], ∫_a^bf,dg is the common limit of sums∑f(ξ_i)(g(t_i)−g(t_{i−1})) as the partition mesh tends to zero, with ξ_i∈[t_{i−1},t_i]. Vector pairings are defined by summing the component integrals.

title: Hilbert–Schmidt operator
description: A bounded linear map B:U→H between Hilbert spaces is Hilbert–Schmidt if ∑_k‖Be_k‖²<∞ for an orthonormal basis(e_k) of U. The square root of this basis-independent sum is its Hilbert–Schmidt norm.

title: Isonormal Gaussian process over a real Hilbert space
description: A linear map W:H→L²(Ω) whose values are centered jointly Gaussian random variables and satisfy E[W(h)W(k)]=⟨h,k⟩_H. It need not be represented by an H-valued Gaussian random variable.

title: Cylindrical Wiener process on a real Hilbert space
description: A family W_t(h),t≥0,h∈U, linear in h, centered jointly Gaussian and adapted, with E[W_t(h)W_s(k)]=min(t,s)⟨h,k⟩ and independent increments relative to the filtration. For each h it is a real Brownian motion scaled by ‖h‖. In infinite dimension the formal sum∑_kβ_k(t)e_k generally is not U-valued.

title: Itô integral against cylindrical Wiener noise
description: For a predictable Hilbert–Schmidt-valued B_s:U→H with E∫₀ᵀ‖B_s‖²_HS ds<∞, ∫₀ᵗB_sdW_s is the L²(Ω;H) limit of the finite sums∑_k∫₀ᵗB_se_kdβ_k(s), where β_k are the independent Brownian coordinates of cylindrical W. Local versions use stopping.

title: Gaussian space-time white noise
description: On a measured spatial set(S,m), Gaussian space-time white noise is an isonormal Gaussian process indexed by L²(ℝ₊×S,dt⊗m). Thus integrals W(f) have covariance∫fg,dt,dm; equivalently W_t(h)=W(1_[0,t]h) is cylindrical Wiener noise on L²(S,m).

title: Stochastic convolution for a Hilbert-space semigroup
description: Given a strongly continuous contraction semigroup S(t) on H, cylindrical Wiener noise W on U and a coefficient B:U→H, the stochastic convolution is Z_t=∫₀ᵗS(t−s)B,dW_s whenever the composed operators are Hilbert–Schmidt with ∫₀ᵗ‖S(t−s)B‖²_HS ds<∞.

title: Unit circle
description: The subspace S¹={(x,y)∈ℝ²:x²+y²=1}, often identified with a2π-periodic angular coordinate and equipped with arc-length measure.

title: Heat semigroup on the circle
description: On the circle parametrized modulo2π, (S_tf)(x)=∫₀²πK_t(x−y)f(y)dy, where K_t(z)=∑_{k∈ℤ}(4πt)^{−1/2}exp(−(z+2πk)²/(4t)). This is the semigroup generated by the periodic Laplacian ∂ₓ².

title: Stochastic heat equation between two reflecting walls
description: On S¹ let h₁<h₂ be continuous walls, f Lipschitz and W space-time white noise. A reflected solution is a continuous adapted u with h₁≤u≤h₂ satisfying du=(∂ₓ²u+f(u))dt+dW+dη₁−dη₂ in the weak test-function sense, for nonnegative reflection measures with∫(u−h₁)dη₁=∫(h₂−u)dη₂=0 on finite time intervals.

title: Cameron–Martin space of a Hilbert Gaussian measure
description: For a centered Gaussian measure on a real separable Hilbert space with covariance Q, take an eigenbasis Qe_k=q_ke_k. Its Cameron–Martin space consists of u=∑_ku_ke_k with u_k=0 when q_k=0 and∑_{q_k>0}|u_k|²/q_k<∞; that sum is its squared norm. Equivalently it is Range(Q¹ᐟ²) with the minimum preimage norm.

title: Distributional order on H⁻¹
description: For u,v∈H⁻¹(Ω), write u≤v if ⟨v−u,φ⟩≥0 for every nonnegative φ∈H₀¹(Ω). This is the usual positive-distribution order, distinct from the order transported by the inverse Dirichlet Laplacian.

title: Stochastic differential inclusion for a convex subdifferential
description: Let η:ℝᵈ→(−∞,∞] be proper lower semicontinuous convex, b Lipschitz and W Brownian. A solution of dX+∂η(X)dt∋b(X)dt+dW is a continuous adapted X in closure(dom∂η) with X_t=x+∫₀ᵗb(X_s)ds+W_t−K_t, K₀=0 of locally bounded variation, such that∫_sᵗ⟨X_r−a,dK_r−a*dr⟩≥0 for all(a,a*)∈graph∂η and0≤s≤t. K need not have a Lebesgue density.

title: Normal cone of a closed convex set
description: For a closed convex D⊂ℝᵈ and x∈D, the outward normal cone is N_D(x)={v:⟨v,y−x⟩≤0 for every y∈D}; it is empty outside D. It equals the convex subdifferential of the extended-real indicator I_D.

title: Variational solution of an additive-noise SPDE
description: On a Gelfand triple V⊂H⊂V*, with cylindrical Wiener noise W and Hilbert–Schmidt B:U→H, a variational solution of dX=A(X)dt+BdW is an adapted H-continuous process with X∈Lᵖ(0,T;V) and A(X)∈L^{p/(p−1)}(0,T;V*) almost surely, satisfying X_t=x+∫₀ᵗA(X_s)ds+∫₀ᵗBdW_s as an identity in V* for every t.

title: Local Dirichlet integral at a closed-disk point
description: For holomorphic f on the unit disk and |ζ|≤1, put Dζ(f)=∫|f′(z)|²ωζ(z)dA(z), with normalized area. For |ζ|<1 use ωζ(z)=2G(z,ζ)/(1−|ζ|²); for |ζ|=1 use the Poisson kernel ωζ(z)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|². The integral may be infinite.

title: Fourier coefficient of an integrable circle function
description: For an integrable function g on the unit circle, its nth Fourier coefficient is ĝ(n)=(2π)⁻¹∫₀²π g(e^{it})e^{−int}dt, for n∈ℤ.

title: Fatou boundary-value theorem for Hardy H²
description: For f(z)=∑a_nzⁿ∈H², radial boundary values f* exist almost everywhere, f(r·)→f* in L² of normalized arc measure, and ∥f*∥²₂=∑|a_n|². Its Fourier coefficients are a_n for n≥0 and zero for n<0.

title: Plancherel theorem for Fourier series on the circle
description: Fourier coefficients give an isometric isomorphism from L² of the probability-normalized unit circle to ℓ²(ℤ). Equivalently, the functions ζ↦ζⁿ, n∈ℤ, are a complete orthonormal system.

title: Poisson convergence at Lebesgue points on the circle
description: For an integrable function g on the unit circle, its Poisson integral converges radially to g(ζ) at every Lebesgue point ζ of g.

title: Green–Poisson identity for the squared modulus of a holomorphic function
description: For holomorphic f on a neighborhood of the closed unit disk and ζ in the disk, ∫_T Pζ|f|²dm−|f(ζ)|²=2∫_D G(z,ζ)|f′(z)|²dA(z), with normalized arc and area measure.

title: Reproducing kernel for a Poisson-weighted Bergman space
description: For |λ|=1, the holomorphic L² space with weight (1−|z|²)/|z−λ|² and normalized area has reproducing kernel 2(z−λ)(w̄−λ̄)/(1−zw̄)³.

title: Boundary growth estimate for Hardy H² functions
description: If g∈H², then (1−|z|²)¹ᐟ²|g(z)|→0 as |z|→1.

title: Uniqueness of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space from its kernel
description: Two Hilbert spaces of functions on the same set with the same reproducing kernel have the same functions, inner product and norm.

title: Local Douglas formula on the closed unit disk
description: For f∈H² and |ζ|≤1, Dζ(f)=∫_T |(f*(λ)−f(ζ))/(λ−ζ)|²dm(λ). At a boundary point ζ, f(ζ) means its radial limit; if that limit does not exist then Dζ(f)=∞. Both sides may be infinite.

title: Strong domination of normalized basic sequences
description: For normalized basic sequences (x_n),(y_n), put Δ(ε)=sup{∥∑a_n y_n∥: a has finite support, max|a_n|≤ε, ∥∑a_n x_n∥≤1}. The first strongly dominates the second if Δ(ε)→0 as ε↓0 and inf_{|A|=m}∥∑_{n∈A}x_n∥→∞ as m→∞.

title: Suppression 1-unconditional, 1-subsymmetric normalized basis
description: A normalized Schauder basis whose coordinate-suppression projections have norm at most one and whose subsequences are isometrically equivalent to the whole basis.

title: Odell’s Schreier unconditionality theorem
description: For every normalized weakly null sequence (x_n) in a Banach space and η>0, some subsequence (y_n) satisfies ∥∑_{i∈F}a_i y_i∥≤(2+η)∥∑a_i y_i∥ for every finitely supported scalar sequence a and every finite F⊂ℕ with |F|≤min F.

title: Brunel–Sucheston spreading-model existence theorem
description: Every normalized basic sequence in a Banach space has a subsequence generating a spreading model; a normalized basic weakly null sequence can be thinned so that the model is normalized, 1-subsymmetric and suppression 1-unconditional.

title: Schlumprecht’s strong-domination and spreading-model criterion
description: Let (e_i) be a suppression1-unconditional,1-subsymmetric normalized basis with ∥∑_{i=1}^m e_i∥→∞, and let (y_i) a normalized basic weakly null sequence. The following are equivalent: some subsequence of (y_i) is strongly dominated by (e_i); some subsequence has a spreading model strongly dominated by (e_i); some subsequence (z_i) satisfies ∥∑a_i z_i∥≤sup_k δ_k max_{i₁<⋯<i_k}∥∑_{j=1}^k a_{i_j}e_j∥ for finitely supported a and positive δ_k↓0. Equivalently, one may use lengths ℓ_k and require k≤i₁<⋯<i_{ℓ_k} in the bound.

title: Hahn–Banach norm-preserving extension theorem
description: A bounded linear functional on a vector subspace of a real or complex normed space extends to the whole space without increasing its norm.

title: ℓ¹ strong domination criterion for weakly null basic sequences
description: A normalized basic weakly null sequence has a subsequence strongly dominated by the ℓ¹ unit vector basis exactly when it has a subsequence whose spreading model is not equivalent to the ℓ¹ unit vector basis.

title: Nilpotent element of a ring
description: An element a such that a^n=0 for some positive integer n.

title: Reduced commutative ring
description: A commutative ring whose only nilpotent element is0.
